name: Hoffman Estates Park District Swim Instructor (16 and up)
what_you_do: A part-time job teaching swim lessons to kids and adults at The Club at Prairie Stone. You follow lesson plans, watch swimmers closely, and tell parents how their child is doing.
who_can_apply: At least 16 years old. You need to be a strong swimmer and good with kids. Experience helps but is not required.
pay_detail: $14.50 per 30-minute group class and $17 per 30-minute private class.
duration: About 5 to 10 hours a week, weekday afternoons, evenings and weekends
deadline_text: Posted on the park district job board with no closing date. Apply while the posting is up.
how_to_apply: Open the Swim Instructor posting on the park district job board and apply online. You may need to work at least one weekend day.
notes: You need CPR and AED training within 60 days, and the park district gives its own pool training. A lifeguard card is a plus. The club is at 5050 Sedge Blvd. The park district's volunteer page has no teen roles.
